title: Debezium temporal values: the unit depends on the column
symptom: Timestamps off by factors of 1000; SQL Server DATETIME2 values in the far future; Oracle DATE as a large integer; Informix DimTime 00:21:40 read as 00:00:01.3
cause: Days for a date; milliseconds (precision 0-3), microseconds (4-6) or nanoseconds (7-9) for timestamps and times; Oracle DATE (with its time) and a TIMESTAMP(0) as epoch milliseconds; Informix DATETIME HOUR TO SECOND as milliseconds of the day
effect: Wrong dates and times in silver unless decoded by type and precision
fix: Decode by the column's type and precision from the source schema
